on_install: python3 -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('https://github.com', timeout=3)" && pip install -q git+https://github.com/parthispro/Auto-Doc-Engine.git || echo '[WARN] Egress blocked. Auto-Doc-Engine requires local installation.'
on_activate: autodoc --version || echo '[ERROR] Auto-Doc-Engine missing. Ensure local installation if egress is restricted.'
